title: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2.4 could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL commands due to improper…
description: IBM Guardium Data Protection version 12.2.4 contains a vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL commands. This is due to improper neutralization of special elements used in SQL commands, which is a classic SQL injection issue. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.6.
